 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Dallas Mavericks are on the road Monday night as they travel to take on the Miami Heat in an interconference matchup.
 Dallas enters Monday's game with a 1-2 record after losing at home to the San Antonio Spurs Saturday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Dallas Mavericks forward Sergio de Larrea (55)Jerome Miron-Imagn Images
 In Saturday's loss, Sergio de Larrea led the way for the Mavericks as he recorded 21 points, five rebounds and four assists off the bench while Daniel Gafford added 12 points, nine rebounds and three steals of his own.
 The Mavericks will try to bounce back Monday as they face off against a struggling Heat team on the road.
 Miami enters Monday's contest with an 0-3 record after losing on the road to the Charlotte Hornets Saturday night.
 Miami Heat center Bam Adebayo (13) Sam Navarro-Imagn Images
 Bam Adebayo led the way for the Heat in Saturday's loss as he ended the game with 20 points, eight rebounds and four assists while Davion Mitchell recorded 22 points and 10 assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Monday night's matchup, one may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Mavericks Injury Report: Will Cooper Flagg, Kyrie Irving Play?
 Dallas Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg.Daniel Dunn-Imagn Images
 The Mavericks have six players listed on their injury report, including forward Cooper Flagg.
 Dallas has listed Flagg as probable and he is expected to return after missing Saturday's loss due to a left shoulder sprain.
 The Mavericks have ruled out Naji Marshall due to an illness as he will miss his first game of the season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Caleb Martin has also been ruled out as he will miss his fourth straight game with a right thumb sprain while Tarik Biberovic is out due to right heel bursitis.
 Dereck Lively II has also been ruled out as he continues to recover from right foot surgery while Santi Aldama remains sidelined while recovering from right knee surgery.
 Dallas Mavericks guard Kyrie IrvingKevin Jairaj-Imagn Images
 The good news for the Mavericks is that Kyrie Irving is off the injury report and will return after missing Saturday's loss due to left knee injury management.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Heat Injury Report
 The Heat enter Monday's contest with a healthy roster as they have nobody listed on their injury report .
 Fans can catch Monday night's matchup between the Mavericks and Heat from the Kaseya Center at 7:30 p.m. ET on NBA TV.
